sentences.en: It's generous of you to teach me some additional things.
sentences.zh: 你愿意教我一些附加的知识真是很慷慨。

sentences.en: My rota is showing a lot of additional working times.
sentences.zh: 我的轮班表上显示有很多追加的工作时间。

sentences.en: Morocco is stationing additional soldiers on its border with Algeria.
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥在其与阿尔及利亚的边境增派了更多士兵。

senses.zh: 额外的，附加的,另外的，追加的,补充,外加
